text.EN: We were supposed to get through this together, {target.name}.
You always had my back, {target.name}. I should've had yours.
text.TL: Lagi mo akong ipinagtatanggol, {target.name}. Dapat ginawa ko rin iyon para sa'yo.

text.EN: I won't let them forget you, {target.name}.

text.TL: Magpahinga ka na, {target.name}. Sapat na ang ginawa mo.

text.EN: We still owed each other a drink, {target.name}.
text.TL: May utang pa tayong inumin sa isa't isa, {target.name}.
